name: NGC 2337 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2337, an irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2337-hubble
story: NGC 2337 has no regular shape; astronomers think galaxies like it may have been warped and deformed by a passing cosmic companion, and such encounters can kickstart the birth of new stars.

claims.text: Some irregular galaxies were warped and deformed by a passing cosmic companion
Gravitational interactions between galaxies can kickstart star formation
ESA/Hubble featured NGC 2337 as 'A lopsided lynx'
